text: dsh-cost-meter 是面向 DSH Web 的状态栏插件，会把模型单价、会话费用、今日总费用和 DeepSeek 账户余额显示在输入框下方。它通过 Web 主机接口读取本地会话用量，并在客户端将统计信息与模型价格呈现为可聚焦的提示信息。插件还能展示按模型和会话拆分的用量与费用，并在余额低时突出显示。适合希望在使用 DSH 时查看会话成本和账户余额的用户。余额查询需要 DeepSeek API 密钥；定价从 DeepSeek 官方页面读取。

dsh-cost-meter adds model prices, session and daily cost estimates, and DeepSeek balance to DSH Web's bottom bar. It reads local session usage and shows cost breakdowns by session and model in a tooltip. Balance lookup needs a DeepSeek API key; pricing comes from DeepSeek's official page.
想在 DSH 页面底部直接看到当前会话大概花了多少钱。
有没有办法查看我今天各个 DSH 会话的费用总和？
Can I keep an eye on my DeepSeek balance while chatting in DSH?
dsh-cost-meter 的功能「会话费用与余额状态栏」：在 DSH Web 输入框下方显示当前会话费用、今日总费用和账户余额，并标示当前模型价格。插件自动定时刷新，聚焦或悬停时可查看会话费用拆分和价格详情。
dsh-cost-meter 的功能「今日用量与费用估算」：主机端扫描本地会话日志，聚合当天 token 用量并按会话及模型计算费用；提示信息还展示按内容类型估算的历史 token 分布。数据由状态栏自动读取，无需用户手动触发。
dsh-cost-meter 使用 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 向 api.deepseek.com 查询账户余额；定价则从 api-docs.deepseek.com 获取，不会把会话日志用于这两项请求。

dsh-cost-meter README · dsh-cost-meter：> 简体中文: [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)

A DSH Web GUI plugin that shows **DeepSeek session cost estimates** and **account balance** in the bottom status bar.

dsh-cost-meter README · Features：In the bottom status bar below the input box (the `conversation.composer.dock` slot, same row as the live-stats stats line; actual labels follow the UI locale):

```
stats row · TPS Flash off-peak 0.05/1.5/4.5 · Today ¥11.52 (5 sessions) · Session ¥0.08 · Balance ¥365.36
```

dsh-cost-meter README · Features：- **Current model live price**: reads the current session's selected model via the `session.models` RPC and shows its live unit price (order: cache hit / cache miss / output, CNY per 1M tokens, model name bold); peak/off-peak pricing switches automatically — **weekends bill at the off-peak (valley) price all day**; updates within ~2.5s after switching the model in the composer.
- **Themed tooltip**: hover/focus shows a bubble matching the current theme (`--dsw-alias-tooltip-bg`) with a per-session cost breakdown, an aligned Flash/Pro price table (bold model names), and the price source with fetch time.
- **Today / session cost**: prices are fetched live from the official DeepSeek pricing page (`api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing`, CNY per 1M tokens, 1h cache) and auto-follow official changes, covering both deepseek-v4-flash and deepseek-v4-pro; falls back to built-in constants (kept in sync with the official page) when the fetch fails. Pricing auto-selects by effective date (2026-08-17 00:00 Beijing) and peak/off-peak hours — peak is Beijing **Mon-Fri 9-12, 14-18** (rest is off-peak); **weekends (Sat/Sun) bill at the off-peak (valley) p

dsh-cost-meter README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/AnakinCao/dsh-cost-meter.git

dsh-cost-meter README · restart dsh web：```

Or no-restart manual mount: put `lib` + `cordis.patch.yml` into `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-cost-meter/`, then append to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-cost-meter
      name: 'dsh-cost-meter'
```

Refresh the page once.

> Pick ONE method — never mount twice.

dsh-cost-meter README · Tuning：Constants at the top of `lib/client.js` (changes hot-apply via HMR in ~0.5s):

- `FALLBACK_PRICES` — built-in fallback prices when the official fetch fails (flash/pro × legacy/off-peak/peak)
- `BALANCE_WARN_CNY` (default `50`) — balance warning threshold
- `MODEL_REFRESH_MS` (default `2500`) — model polling interval (local RPC, negligible cost)
- `REFRESH_MS` (default `60000`) — balance/today/pricing refresh interval
dsh-cost-meter README · Tuning：Host cache: env `DSH_COST_METER_REFRESH_MS` or `config.refreshMs` (default 60000ms).

dsh-cost-meter README · Notes：- Costs are estimates (official unit prices × usage); the authoritative bill is the DeepSeek platform.
- Balance/pricing calls run in the host process (the API key never leaves the browser); routes: `/dsh-cost-meter/api/balance`, `/today`, `/pricing`.
- No token consumption: cost reads local session logs; balance/pricing use account/docs endpoints — no model inference, no billing.
- Uninstall: remove the profile patch insert + delete `node_modules/dsh-cost-meter`.
